verdict.rationale: Zero documents an MCP server with email, draft and label tools, and its README calls it developer-friendly. Nothing in the evidence shows API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation policy. This axis applies to a self-hostable email product with a programmatic interface, so the missing evidence makes the verdict "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
